title: Fluorescence Microscope Operation Procedure
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7cmhiu6

steps.title: Prepare slide with sample
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL bacterial solution to a microslide on a clean workbench, then place a cover slide on top.

steps.title: Set up microscope illumination
steps.instruction: Turn off the room lights and switch on the microscope mercury lamp.

steps.title: Select fluorescence filter
steps.instruction: Choose the filter that matches the luciferin label used with the sample.

steps.title: Position sample and adjust view
steps.instruction: Place the prepared slide on the microscope stage, locate the correct field of view, and ensure the camera is loaded with color film if an image will be taken.

steps.title: Capture image with camera
steps.instruction: Turn on the selfie device (camera) and select the manual file; acquire the image within 0.5 to 10 seconds.

steps.title: Shut down and record use
steps.instruction: Turn off all power to the microscope and related devices, then record the usage details.
